soi.text: Markov Manor is Jace's best lead in the search for Sorin, though Liliana warns that it is even worse than where they have been.
He finds it shattered and hanging apart over a chasm, crosses the floating stones with telekinesis, and discovers a great hall of floating rubble with dozens of vampires petrified in the stone.
There he finds the stone body of a dead man clutching a journal, and visions show Edgar Markov and twelve vampires drinking an angel's silver blood, perhaps the birth of Innistrad's vampires.
The journal says that Sorin made Avacyn, and Jace leaves the manor with it, hoping it will help him find Sorin; Sorin himself later hears from Olivia that his grandfather's manor is in ruins.

emn.text: Nahiri, called the Harbinger by her cultists, waits at Markov Manor for Sorin, and when his vampire army arrives she steps out sword in hand to welcome him.
In the great hall she kills vampires and tells Sorin she brought Emrakul to his doorstep, then rotates the hall and releases scores of Emrakul-touched monsters that attack the vampires.
Sorin chases her through the floating ruins and stabs her, but she traps him in a stone cocoon and planeswalks away from Innistrad.
Olivia then declares their bargain fulfilled and leaves Sorin in stone as Emrakul drifts toward Thraben.
